note: Egypt: the Gulf states' citizens enter without a visa for 6 months, Hong Kong, Jordan and Macao for 3 (Jordan's on a normal 5-year passport only), Malaysia 14 days; nationals of the countries IATA's Timatic lists get a tourist visa on arrival for 30 days, and those on the e-Visa list not among them (India, Iraq for ages 16 to 60, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo) apply online for 30 days. The countries the Embassy in the United States names need a pre-approved visa; everyone else a visa from a mission. Age- and sex-conditioned exemptions (Libya, Algeria, Morocco, Tunisia and others) and the Sinai 15-day stamp aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
